feature: Schedule Phase 4B project resource calendars and preview-only leveling

flows.name: Project capacity profile replacement
steps: Open the canonical schedule resource panel
Edit sparse weekday and dated capacity facts for an existing resource
Save through compare-and-swap and reload the canonical profile
flows.expectedOutcome: The complete valid profile is replaced atomically while stale, unauthorized, malformed, inactive, and cross-project writes fail specifically

flows.name: Preview-only resource leveling
steps: Compare every task scheduling field before and after
flows.expectedOutcome: The preview exposes proposed delays and diagnostics without persisting any task field

checks: Project capacity remains progressively disclosed on the canonical schedule page
Capacity scope is labeled as project-specific
Leveling is labeled preview-only and exposes no Apply action
Errors and unresolved diagnostics remain visible

claims.description: A resource capacity profile is replaced atomically with stale-editor protection
Allocation and leveling use one precedence contract and one coherent database read snapshot
Resource leveling proposes delay-only dates and never mutates schedule tasks
New revisions capture immutable complete resource-capacity context with explicit legacy provenance
